entities.summary: Robert Earl Kenney was an All-State basketball player at Winfield High School in Winfield, Kansas as well as an American basketball player who competed in the Basketball at the 1952 Summer Olympics. He was part of the American basketball team, which won the gold medal in seven matches. Prior to that, he played for the University of Kansas team.
